title: wigl widget package.json
description: Only the fields resolvePluginConfig (src/wigl/plugins/types.ts) actually reads, plus plain bun-run scripts. No npm publish metadata — a widget's id is its folder name, never this file, and it's never published. See docs/widgets.md.

main.description: Overrides the built entry path. Defaults to .wigl/index.js.

dependencies.description: npm dependencies bundled into this widget's own build.

scripts.description: bun-run scripts local to this widget (e.g. a CLI companion). Not read by the widget loader/build — plain bun convention, invoked with `bun run --cwd wigl-widgets/<name> <script>`.

instantiable.description: Whether a second (third, ...) instance of this widget may be created via "Duplicate". Default true. Set false if this widget assumes a global singleton it can't safely share across instances (a fixed server port, a lock file not scoped per instance, etc).
